rowFilter.notification_outbox.exclude_to.name: exclude_token
rowFilter.notification_outbox.exclude_to.description: FCM token of the device that caused the event; it is skipped when fanning out. Null sends to every device.

rowFilter.notification_outbox.dedupe_key.name: dedupe_key
rowFilter.notification_outbox.dedupe_key.description: Uniqueness key so a repeated scan cannot re-notify. Null means "always distinct".

rowFilter.w_document_wallet.consent.name: consent
rowFilter.w_document_wallet.consent.description: True when the user approved the save-consent sheet. The app refuses to save without it.

rowFilter.view_once_shares.access_key.name: access_key
rowFilter.view_once_shares.access_key.description: Short-lived grant minted at claim time so the claiming client can fetch the bytes after the token is burned.

rowFilter.view_once_shares.view_seconds.name: view_seconds
rowFilter.view_once_shares.view_seconds.description: How many seconds the document stays on screen after the recipient opens it. 0 = no limit. Distinct from expiry_time, which bounds the unopened link.

rowFilter.w_password_vault.nickname.name: nickname
rowFilter.w_password_vault.nickname.description: A decoy label the user invents. The UI tells them NOT to use the real site/app name.

rowFilter.w_password_vault.password.name: password
rowFilter.w_password_vault.password.description: Client-side-encrypted (AES-GCM) password. NEVER write a plaintext credential here.

rowFilter.w_password_vault.consent.name: consent
rowFilter.w_password_vault.consent.description: True when the user approved the save-consent dialog. The app refuses to save without it.

rowFilter.vault_documents.shared_by.name: shared_by
rowFilter.vault_documents.shared_by.description: Who contributed the document. An editor may withdraw only their own; admins and the owner may remove any.

rowFilter.vault_documents.object_path.name: object_path
rowFilter.vault_documents.object_path.description: Exact storage object name in the `documents` bucket. The storage RLS policy joins on this - changing the format here silently breaks member downloads.

rowFilter.vault_documents.is_hidden.name: is_hidden
rowFilter.vault_documents.is_hidden.description: Master switch. While true, only the contributor and vault admins/owners can see the row OR open its file — enforced by the RLS policies below, not by the client.

rowFilter.vault_documents.shared_fields.name: shared_fields
rowFilter.vault_documents.shared_fields.description: Disclosure mask, {"price": false, "address": true, …}. Which fields of the source wallet record the contributor agreed to expose.

rowFilter.vault_documents.shared_data.name: shared_data
rowFilter.vault_documents.shared_data.description: The field values that survived shared_fields. Denormalized for the same reason the name/category are: the source row is owner-scoped and unreadable to co-members.

rowFilter.vault_documents.source_ref.name: source_ref
rowFilter.vault_documents.source_ref.description: The source wallet record's own id as TEXT — uuid for synced records, prop_17…/inv_17… for ones still device-local. Unique per vault so re-sharing updates in place.

rowFilter.w_cards_wallet.consent.name: consent
rowFilter.w_cards_wallet.consent.description: True when the user approved the save-consent sheet. The app refuses to save without it.

rowFilter.user_qr_codes.image_base64.name: image_base64
rowFilter.user_qr_codes.image_base64.description: Base64 PNG of the QR auto-cropped out of the uploaded photo, not the original photo.

rowFilter.user_qr_codes.payload.name: payload
rowFilter.user_qr_codes.payload.description: Decoded QR contents (e.g. upi://pay?pa=…). Null when the image held no readable code.

rowFilter.user_qr_codes.payee_vpa.name: payee_vpa
rowFilter.user_qr_codes.payee_vpa.description: VPA parsed from payload, for display only. A VPA can receive money, never spend it.

rowFilter.reminders.last_push_sent_on.name: last_push_sent_on
rowFilter.reminders.last_push_sent_on.description: Date this reminder last triggered a push. Prevents duplicate sends when the cron runs twice in a day.

rowFilter.reminders.due_at.name: due_at
rowFilter.reminders.due_at.description: Exact moment the reminder fires (timestamptz). Authoritative; due_date is the derived calendar day.

rowFilter.reminders.notified_at.name: notified_at
rowFilter.reminders.notified_at.description: When the due-time push was delivered. Null = not yet sent. Reset automatically when due_at changes.

rowFilter.w_ino_share_cache.consent.name: consent
rowFilter.w_ino_share_cache.consent.description: True when the user approved the save-consent sheet. The app refuses to save without it.

rowFilter.w_health_wallet.category.name: category
rowFilter.w_health_wallet.category.description: Document Type in the UI: X-Ray | Prescription | Lab Report | Discharge Summary | Vaccine Record | Other.

rowFilter.w_health_wallet.record_number.name: record_number
rowFilter.w_health_wallet.record_number.description: Populated from OCR extraction, not typed by the user.

rowFilter.w_health_wallet.notes.name: notes
rowFilter.w_health_wallet.notes.description: Free-text notes, or an encoded DocumentExtraction envelope when OCR found fields.

rowFilter.w_health_wallet.expires_at.name: expires_at
rowFilter.w_health_wallet.expires_at.description: Next Appointment Date in the UI; also drives the auto-created reminder.

rowFilter.w_health_wallet.consent.name: consent
rowFilter.w_health_wallet.consent.description: True when the user approved the save-consent sheet. The app refuses to save without it.

rowFilter.vault_keys.salt.name: salt
rowFilter.vault_keys.salt.description: Base64 PBKDF2 salt. Public by design; prevents precomputation, not disclosure.

rowFilter.vault_keys.verifier.name: verifier
rowFilter.vault_keys.verifier.description: The constant ino.vault.v1 sealed with the derived key, so a wrong passphrase is distinguishable from a corrupt vault.

rowFilter.expenses.direction.name: direction
rowFilter.expenses.direction.description: Money direction: 'credited' (in) or 'debited' (out). Null on legacy rows → derived from type.

rowFilter.w_identity_wallet.consent.name: consent
rowFilter.w_identity_wallet.consent.description: True when the user approved the save-consent sheet. The app refuses to save without it.

rowFilter.w_property_wallet.image_path.name: image_path
rowFilter.w_property_wallet.image_path.description: Storage object path (<uid>/<ts>.<ext>) in the `documents` bucket, NOT a device path. The app uploads the photo before saving the row.

rowFilter.w_property_wallet.attachments.name: attachments
rowFilter.w_property_wallet.attachments.description: Array of {id, kind, name, path, …}. `path` is a storage object path, uploaded before the row is written.

rowFilter.w_property_wallet.consent.name: consent
rowFilter.w_property_wallet.consent.description: True when the user approved the save-consent sheet. The app refuses to save without it.

rowFilter.w_property_wallet.reminder_dat.description: Optional scheduled reminder timestamp for this property (tax due, lease renewal, EMI).
